title: Probabilistic Stability Transfer for One-Dimensional Euler Characteristic Transforms
summary: The Euler characteristic transform (ECT) is a computable topological signature for shapes embedded in Euclidean space. Existing ECT stability results control changes in the transform through deterministic geometric perturbation bounds, but many data-generating mechanisms produce perturbations that are random and unbounded in the worst case. In such settings a uniform deterministic bound may be unavailable or too pessimistic. This paper formulates a probabilistic stability-transfer principle for one-dimensional ECT stability: a deterministic stability estimate is combined with a tail bound…
